strategy.label: MA趋势跟随-高弹性止盈-移除MACD过滤
strategy.hypothesis: 8%/16% 止盈已经出现 1 个达标样本但覆盖太窄；继续提高到 10%/20%，检验更高收益弹性是否能扩大达标样本数，同时确认最大回撤仍压在 10% 内。
strategy.name: trend-follow-maximum-profit-no-macd

objective.name: 策略进化后三年全市场复核
objective.note: 每完成一次策略进化后，必须跑三年全市场逐标的复核；收益前10和收益后10都要审计，组合级共享资金回测是后续增强。

scope.unit_note: 派生实验上下文：提高全市场候选池流动性与市值阈值，用于检验尾部亏损是否来自低质量候选池。min_avg_amount 单位为千元，min_avg_circ_mv 单位为万元。

market_breadth_scope.unit_note: 市场宽度使用更宽的非 ST、非北交所、上市满一年样本，只要求足够 K 线；交易候选池仍使用 scope 中的高流动性和市值过滤。

market_state_source.note: allowedEntryDates uses the entry-date marketRiskOn flag from the portfolio diagnostic equity curve, based on previous trading day breadth.

portfolioOverride.note: portfolio_target.maxSinglePositionPct was overridden before building portfolio rules.

entryRiskOverride.note: portfolio_target.entryRiskFilter was overridden before building portfolio rules.

executionStress.note: Execution stress was applied before building the strategy config. It changes fill prices and optional entry blocking, not entry signal semantics.

crossSectionScoreWeightOverride.note: Cross-section score weights were overridden before building portfolio rules.

industryStateFilterOverride.note: Industry state filter was overridden before building portfolio rules.

moneyflowCacheOverride.note: Point-in-time moneyflow ranks are loaded from a run-local cache; no database schema is changed.
